title: F35 · empty_room · The Empty Room
lines: She still listens for the key at seven.
The room is so tidy it hurts.
She is doing well, she tells everyone.
"She is doing well," she tells everyone.
And then she sits on the bed, in the dark.
In the window glass, a river was pouring down out of the sky, and a pair of hands was catching it.
He did not keep her. He held her until she could go gently.
Her phone lit up. A photo: her daughter, laughing, with new friends, wearing the earrings she had packed for her.
You held her so she could flow. This is what it was for. That is sadhana.
